RetentionDisclosure.independent_verification: Node evidence validators independently validate optional version-1 effects while retaining exact source/encoded spans and legacy receipts. Scalar v2 accepts only the untouched native result plus a matching semantic footer; malformed/false-zero receipts and altered spans fail. The projection module uses an explicit .ts runtime import so Node 24 evidence consumers can load the same compiler.
RetentionDisclosure.model_instruction_review: A real natural no-write request omitted readOnly and incurred six retention writes; the final answer mentioned unchanged author content but did not disclose retained writes. Both scalar read and notion_use descriptions now explicitly require readOnly:true for user read-only/no-write intent and retained/unknown disclosure in the final answer. Guard, effect state, body spans and finite-model transitions are unchanged. This instruction change needs real Pi verification and does not prove arbitrary LLM compliance.
